start.title: Getting started
start.subtitle: Simulations of the real path, inside Bitrix24. Pick a topic and click the orange highlight to move on.
start.hint: Click the orange highlight on the screen:

install.label: Installation
install.intro: From the Bitrix24 Market to the app installed on your portal.

1.title: Find GPTThink in the Market
1.text: In your Bitrix24, open the Market, search for GPTThink and click the app card.

2.title: Install from the app page
2.text: The GPTThink page opens over the catalog, with the developer (CRMThink). Click Install.

3.title: Accept the terms and finish
3.text: On the installation screen, accept the Bitrix24 Market terms and finish.

create.label: Create the agent
create.intro: From the list of agents to your first agent.

1.title: Start a new agent
1.text: Open GPTThink from the applications menu. In the list of agents, click New agent.

2.title: Choose the function
2.text: Each agent has a function (Support, SDR, Scheduling…). Pick the one that fits your service and move on.

3.title: Review and create
3.text: In the preview, see what will be created and confirm. You can still adjust everything later.

train.label: Train
train.intro: What the agent knows about your business.

1.title: Open Trainings
1.text: Inside the agent, go to the Trainings tab.

2.title: Add what the agent should know
2.text: The knowledge base items come from the function form, and you can add your own. Training does not use credits.

3.title: Test the conversation
3.text: With the base ready, click Test and talk to the agent before putting it to work.

intentions.label: Intents and functions
intentions.intro: Actions the agent performs during the conversation.

1.title: Open Intents
1.text: Ready-made functions already bring intents. To see and adjust them, go to the agent’s Intents tab.

2.title: Create an intent
2.text: Define the name, when to use it and what the agent should collect from the customer. Click New intent.

3.title: Activate and follow up
3.text: Keep the intent active so the agent can use it, and check History to see when it was used.

channel.label: Open channel
channel.intro: Put the agent to work in Bitrix24.

1.title: Open the Open channels
1.text: In the Bitrix24 Contact Center, go to Open channels and open the channel you will use.

2.title: Choose the agent
2.text: In the channel settings, under Chatbot, select the GPTThink agent.

3.title: Save and you are done
3.text: Save the channel. The next conversations on it are handled by the agent.

1.title: Open Credits and plan
1.text: In the GPTThink menu, go to Credits and plan.

2.title: Start the free trial
2.text: When a free trial is available, start it here so the agent can begin serving.

3.title: Follow the balance
3.text: See the total available and your agents’ usage. You get warnings before credits run out.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Do I need to know how to code to create an agent?
faq.a1: No. You create the agent, describe its behavior and train it in the app itself, inside Bitrix24.
faq.q2: On which channels does the agent respond?
faq.a2: On the Bitrix24 open channels you connect to the agent.
faq.q3: Can the agent use my CRM data?
faq.a3: Yes. It can read and write information in Bitrix24 while serving the customer, according to the actions you enable.
faq.q4: Can I test the agent before putting it to work?
faq.a4: Yes. The test chat lets you talk to the agent before activating it on the channel.
faq.q5: What happens when credits run out?
faq.a5: Consumption is tracked inside the app, and you get warnings before the balance runs out. Check your balance in the plan area.
faq.q6: Can my team take over a conversation?
faq.a6: Yes. You define when the conversation goes to a person on your team, and the history stays on the channel.
